case: Software record with thirteen versions under one concept DOI
note: THE most important Zenodo case. The identity is the CONCEPT doi 10.5281/zenodo.4549875, never the version doi 10.5281/zenodo.15... of this particular release: thirteen versions are ONE catalogue record whose files are its resources. The version doi survives as source.extra.zenodo_version_doi and as the IsVersionOf related identifier. Note the source_key pairs the revision with the version doi: the previous version (record 18421933, v3.1.4) also has revision 4, so a bare-revision key would have missed this release.
